children: A wave of network failures resembling the effects of a major cyberattack was self-inflicted, Bloomberg senior cybersecurity reporter Jordan Robertson said on Bloomberg This Weekend, according to Bloomberg. He cited risks from aging infrastructure, interconnected systems, staffing cuts and rapid AI adoption.
The disruptions are fueling renewed interest in doomsday prepping, while Robertson said a prolonged cyber catastrophe remains unlikely.

title: Network Failures Drive Renewed Interest in Doomsday Prepping
